description_en: Queries the Wi-Fi configuration of a Smart Access Gateway instance
name: DescribeSagWifi

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

AuthenticationType.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

NONE: Authentication is disabled.
WPA-PSK: WPA-PSK authentication is enabled.
WPA2-PSK: WPA2-PSK authentication is enabled
AuthenticationType.description_zh:
认证类型：

NONE：未开启认证。
WPA-PSK：开启WPA-PSK认证。
WPA2-PSK：开启WPA2-PSK认证

Bandwidth.description_en:
The spectrum bandwidth. Valid values:

Auto.
20MHz.
40MHz

EncryptAlgorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

AUTO: Automatic encryption.
TKIP: Temporal Key Integrity Protocol.
AES: Advanced Encryption Standard
EncryptAlgorithm.description_zh:
加密算法：

AUTO：自动加密。
TKIP：临时密钥完整性协议。
AES：WiFi授权的高效加密标准

IsAuth.description_en:
Indicates whether the wireless security feature is enabled. Valid values:

True: The wireless security feature is enabled.
False: The wireless security feature is disabled
IsAuth.description_zh:
无线安全是否打开：

True：无线安全功能打开。
False：无线安全功能未打开

IsBroadcast.description_en:
Indicates whether the Wi-Fi broadcast feature is enabled. Valid values:

True: The Wi-Fi broadcast feature is enabled.
False: The Wi-Fi broadcast feature is disabled
IsBroadcast.description_zh:
Wifi广播功能是否打开：

True：Wifi广播功能打开。
False：Wifi广播功能未打开

IsEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the wireless feature is enabled. Valid values:

True: Enabled.
False: Disabled
IsEnable.description_zh:
无线功能是否开启：

True：是。
False：否

TaskStates.description_en: The status of the query task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. A value of Successful indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will be delivered after the device goes online.
Succeed: The query task is delivered.
Processing: The query task is being delivered.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the Smart Access Gateway device does not support this feature.
BuildRequestError: The management system does not support the operation.
HardwareError: The query task fails to be delivered due to device errors.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will not be delivered even after the device goes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
